summary.id: Pengelolaan hunian vertikal terpadu, kemitraan PPPSRS, kenyamanan penghuni, dan keandalan fasilitas bersama.
summary.en: Integrated vertical living management, PPPSRS partnership, resident comfort, and shared facility reliability.

detail.id: Mendampingi pemilik dan pengurus PPPSRS dalam menciptakan lingkungan hunian yang tertib, pengelolaan IPL & Sinking Fund yang transparan, penanganan komplain unit yang responsif, serta perawatan fasilitas bersama.
detail.en: Partnering with owners and PPPSRS boards to maintain orderly living environments, transparent IPL and Sinking Fund accounting, responsive unit servicing, and well-kept shared amenities.

summary.id: Operasional gedung perkantoran korporat, keandalan sistem M&E, keamanan terpadu, dan efisiensi biaya (OPEX).
summary.en: Commercial tower operations, M&E systems reliability, integrated security, and operating cost (OPEX) efficiency.

detail.id: Menjaga kontinuitas bisnis penyewa korporat melalui pemeliharaan preventif sistem pendingin (HVAC), lift, kelistrikan, tata graha ruang kerja, serta pengendalian biaya operasional (OPEX) gedung perkantoran.
detail.en: Supporting business continuity for corporate tenants through preventive maintenance of HVAC, elevators, electrical systems, executive housekeeping, and disciplined OPEX control.

summary.id: Manajemen pusat perbelanjaan dan gedung komersial, koordinasi tenant ritel, kebersihan, dan ketertiban area publik.
summary.en: Shopping center and commercial property management, retail tenant coordination, cleanliness, and public area order.

detail.id: Mengelola alur pengunjung, pengawasan fit-out penyewa ritel, kebersihan area komersial bertrafik tinggi, manajemen parkir, serta kesiapan utilitas pendukung operasional setiap hari.
detail.en: Managing visitor flow, retail tenant fit-out supervision, high-traffic commercial housekeeping, parking operations, and daily utility readiness.

summary.id: Pengelolaan klaster hunian dan residensial, tata lingkungan rapi, perawatan lanskap, sistem drainase, dan keamanan 24 jam.
summary.en: Residential cluster management, organized environment, landscape upkeep, drainage systems, and 24/7 security.

detail.id: Pengelolaan lingkungan klaster perumahan yang mencakup perawatan taman, jalan, saluran air, pengelolaan sampah, serta sistem keamanan lingkungan 24 jam.
detail.en: Residential cluster management covering parks, roadways, stormwater drainage, waste management, and dedicated 24-hour estate security.

summary.id: Manajemen kawasan distrik multi-fungsi, integrasi fasilitas bersama, koordinasi utilitas, dan kelancaran mobilitas kawasan.
summary.en: Multi-functional district area management, shared amenities integration, utility coordination, and traffic flow.

detail.id: Manajemen operasional kawasan distrik terpadu, sinkronisasi utilitas publik, pengelolaan area komunal multi-properti, dan ketertiban tata ruang kawasan.
detail.en: Operational governance for mixed-use districts, common utility synchronization, multi-property communal space management, and district zoning compliance.

summary.id: Pengelolaan skala kota mandiri secara komprehensif, infrastruktur makro, WTP/STP kawasan, dan tata kelola lingkungan terpadu.
summary.en: Comprehensive township-scale management, macro infrastructure, regional WTP/STP, and sustainable environmental care.

detail.id: Pengelolaan kota mandiri berskala makro mencakup pemeliharaan infrastruktur umum, instalasi air bersih (WTP) & limbah (STP), PJU, dan manajemen kelestarian lingkungan kawasan.
detail.en: Macro-scale township management covering regional utilities, municipal water & wastewater systems (WTP/STP), public lighting, and sustainable environmental preservation.
